art_direction: 银雪翠梦：纯二维动漫画法，柔和短鹅蛋脸、平缓颧骨、圆润下颌、清透琥珀眼，珍珠白长卷发与翡翠绿夏裙；海边花园的钴蓝、青绿、绯红与橘色形成鲜明撞色。
composition_variation: Near-frontal head-to-below-waist portrait, soft head tilt, clear facial contour and a small white flower held at waist. Bright cel-shaded 2D drawing, not photorealistic.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory jewel-pearl-blossom-retry/native. Canonical wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.hair: Pearl-white long waves with light silver-lavender cel shadows
wallpaper.title: 银雪翠梦 · 花间晴风
wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 589x1280 JPEG of canonical wallpaper. Clear 2D anime rendering, softly modeled oval face with golden eyes and a gentle smile, pearl-white long waves and an orange-red flower at the ear. Opaque green short-sleeved dress; visible fingers hold a white flower stem coherently near the lower-right edge. Saturated blue sky and turquoise sea with red flowers, clear upper sky, no text, watermark, extra limbs or unwanted people.

visible_description: 银白长卷发女性耳边别着橘红花，金色双眼含笑望向镜头；身穿翠绿短袖夏裙，双手轻握小白花，青蓝海天与绯红花簇衬托清透面容。
